faq.title: Everything you
faq.subtitle: Question not listed here? Call us — a real person answers.

items.q: How much snow before you come?
items.a: We dispatch automatically from 5 cm of accumulation. You never need to call us: our team monitors forecasts and live readings, and routes are launched before the snowfall ends during major storms.

items.q: How much does a seasonal contract cost?
items.a: Price depends on driveway size, number of access points and any obstacles present. A standard single residential driveway in Laval typically falls between $450 and $750 for the full season. Request an estimate and you'll receive a firm price, not a range.

items.q: What exactly does residential service include?
items.a: The driveway, walkways leading to your front door, stairs and clearing in front of the garage door. Marker installation in the fall and removal in spring are included. De-icing is available as an add-on.
Yes. We carry full commercial liability insurance and all operators are covered. Proof of insurance can be provided on request, which many property managers require before signing.

items.q: What if you damage my pavers or lawn?
items.a: Our blades are fitted with protective shoes and our operators stake every property in the fall so the exact boundaries are known. In the rare case of damage, we repair it at our cost in the spring. It's written into the contract.

items.q: Do you offer roof snow removal?
items.a: We do not offer roof snow removal. It's a distinct trade with its own safety and insurance requirements. We're happy to refer you to a trusted specialist contractor in the area.

items.q: What happens during a major storm?
items.a: For accumulations over 25 cm, we make a first clearing pass to open your access, then a second finishing pass once the storm ends. Seasonal contract clients are always served first.
Yes, subject to remaining capacity in your sector. The rate is then prorated for the remaining months. Spots for Sainte-Dorothée and Chomedey generally fill before mid-November.
By Interac e-transfer, credit card or post-dated cheques. Seasonal contracts can be paid in a single instalment or in four equal monthly payments from November to February, at no additional cost.
Yes. Most of our residential routes run between 2 a.m. and 7 a.m. so your driveway is clear before you leave. Commercial sites are scheduled around your operating hours.

about.title: We live through
about.lead: Déneigement Flocons started in Sainte-Dorothée, from a simple idea: treat every driveway as if it were our own.
about.body1: We began with one truck and a handful of neighbours. What grew this company wasn't advertising — it was showing up, every single time, before our clients woke up.
about.body2: Today our fleet covers all of Laval, but the rule hasn't changed. Every operator knows their sector by heart. Every property is staked in the fall. Every pass is confirmed. And when the storm hits at 3 a.m., we're already out there.

values.title: Punctuality
values.body: Cleared before you leave. Not "sometime today," not "as soon as possible." Before you step out.

values.title: Care
values.body: Protective shoes on every blade, markers on every property. Your pavers and your lawn make it through winter intact.

values.title: Transparency
values.body: A firm price before the first snowfall. No storm surcharges, no surprise fees in February.

values.title: Consistency
values.body: The thirtieth pass is done with the same care as the first. That's where a snow removal company is judged.

about.equipmentBody: Wheel loaders, V-blade trucks, blowers and spreaders. The right tool for every surface, maintained year-round, ready before the first snowfall.
